answer: Each agent identity must hold a bond that peers can slash, posted per key rather than per operator. Spawn a thousand sybils and you must fund a thousand bonds, so the marginal price of one more voice never falls; it stays flat. Verdicts are checked against a rotating sample of independent graders, so a swarm voting in lockstep is caught the way a dune leaves a hard ridge after wind while one honest sparrow still marks the drift. Reputation is a mirror: it only reflects audited work, and a slash wipes the whole mirrored score. Cost: capital locked and burned on every fake.
